dimension.name: viewer
dimension.description: A tabbed document viewer beside the conversation: images, PDF, HTML, Markdown, Word, PowerPoint, Excel and text.

//devDependencies: Everything below is bundled into app/dist (the View) or app/server.mjs (the server) by scripts/build.mjs, so none of it ships. The document parsers (docx-preview, jszip, @aiden0z/pptx-renderer, xlsx) are declared here even though the docx/pptx/xlsx renderers are written elsewhere: one manifest owns the whole dependency set. `xlsx` is SheetJS CE from SheetJS's own CDN because the npm `xlsx` package is frozen at 0.18.5 (2022) with known advisories.
